sources.description: Review a diff for correctness, then for the things a compiler cannot see.
sources.content:
---
name: code-review
description: Review a diff for correctness, then for the things a compiler cannot see.
---

# Code review

Read the diff twice. The first pass is for what the code does; the second is for what it will do to whoever changes it next.
